capture.selection: Names, titles, descriptions, and annotations from the authenticated live tools/list response.

tools.name: finfold_create_growth_mission
tools.title: Create a Finfold growth mission
tools.description: Reads one public business URL and creates one evidence-bound growth mission, one platform-native content asset, and one tracked CTA. Mutation: persists the mission. It never publishes content or modifies an external account. Requires mission:create. Retry only with the same idempotencyKey.

tools.name: finfold_get_growth_mission
tools.title: Get a Finfold growth mission
tools.description: Reads a persisted mission, its anonymous attribution totals, verdict, and next action. Read-only with no side effects. Requires mission:read.

tools.name: finfold_record_growth_outcome
tools.title: Record a Finfold growth outcome
tools.description: Records one attributable lead, signup, purchase, or revenue event inside the mission measurement window and recomputes the verdict. Revenue must use the mission target currency. Mutation: writes one idempotent outcome. No external side effects. Requires outcome:write. Retry with the same eventId and idempotencyKey.
